mapper.sql: delivery_id, user_id, channel, business_key, business_key_hash, payload_hash, status, attempt_count, last_result, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_user_push_delivery ( user_id, channel, business_key, business_key_hash, payload_hash, status, attempt_count, last_result, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{channel}, #{businessKey}, #{businessKeyHash}, #{payloadHash}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{lastResult}, #{lastError}, #{version}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_user_push_delivery set status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_result = null, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and version = #{version} and (status != 'SENDING' or updated_time <= #{staleSendingBefore})

update sys_user_push_delivery set status = 'SENT', last_result = #{lastResult}, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update sys_user_push_delivery set status = 'SKIPPED', last_result = #{lastResult}, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update sys_user_push_delivery set status = 'RETRY', last_result = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update sys_user_push_delivery set status = 'DEAD', last_result = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}
